Commitment.title: Commitment
Commitment.description: A financial commitment (verplichting) tracked from the moment it becomes legally binding (purchase order signed, framework agreement agreed, employment contract executed, grant decision awarded) through delivery, invoicing, payment, and closure. Drives budget-blocking at commitment-time and mandate enforcement on aangaan. The status field is the lifecycle field; every state change is recorded as an immutable CommitmentMovement (D1). The tegenpartij is an embedded vendor reference (kvk/naam/iban) — not a bespoke customer schema; a customer/contact is a Nextcloud entity (ADR). THIS FRAGMENT IS THE SINGLE OWNER OF THIS SCHEMA'S `required` LIST: ADR-037's deepMergeConfig() CONCATENATES list values, so a second fragment declaring `required` makes the effective list the UNION of both and no payload of either model can satisfy it. Overlay fragments (20-bookkeeping-tenderned-integratie.json) contribute properties only.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this verplichting for tenant isolation (IDOR-safe scoping).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

commitmentNumber.description: Operator-assigned unique commitment number within the administration. This is the single spelling: the camelCase `verplichtingNummer` variant that TenderNedAwardDetectedListener once wrote is gone — every writer (CommitmentMaterialisationService, TenderNedAwardDetectedListener) and every reader (BudgetBlocker::canCommit, MandateEnforcer::hasSufficientMandate, CommitmentGuard, RequisitionService) now agrees on `commitmentNumber`.
commitmentNumber.title: Verplichtingsnummer

sourceReference.description: Provenance reference for auto-materialised commitments: the poNumber of the approved PurchaseOrder or the contractNumber of the signed Contract this Commitment was raised from. Used as the idempotency key so a repeated approval/signature transition never creates a duplicate commitment. Null for manually-created commitments.
sourceReference.title: Bron Referentie

aangaan.label: Verplichting aangaan
aangaan.description: Sign the commitment within mandaat and budget. Gated by MandateEnforcer (mandaat sufficient) and BudgetBlocker (vrije_ruimte sufficient or override). A `committed` CommitmentMovement is recorded (REQ-VPL-001/002).

actions.description: Record a `committed` CommitmentMovement and increase openstaande_verplichtingen on the matching budgets (REQ-VPL-001/003).

goedkeuren.label: Goedkeuren

factureren.label: Factureren

betalen.label: Betalen
betalen.description: Payment settled; openstaande_verplichtingen unchanged (already released at gefactureerd, REQ-VPL-003).

afsluiten.label: Afsluiten

annuleren.label: Annuleren
annuleren.description: Cancel; reversal mutatie posted, openstaande_verplichtingen reduced.

commitment-approval.description: Approval chain that gates the Commitment in_approval -> committed `goedkeuren` transition. A commitment reaches in_approval only when MandateEnforcer::requiresApproval routed it there because the signer's mandaat was insufficient; this chain then runs the finance approval workflow that releases it. Threshold-routed on totaalbedrag_excl_btw (EUR cents): a single commitment-administrator approves from EUR 0, and a finance-director approves commitments at or above EUR 250.000. Separation of duties is enforced - the requester who submitted the commitment cannot approve their own step. On completion the goedkeuren transition auto-advances (BudgetBlocker still gates the budget). Declarative metadata only: OpenRegister's approval-workflow primitive (x-openregister-approval-chains, ApprovalChainGateListener/ApprovalChainAdvanceListener) materialises and gates the actual steps; this app ships no PHP approval-chain implementation. INERT until the OpenRegister release carrying the declarative approval-chains capability (PR #396/#397) is deployed - see openspec/changes/migrate-mandaat-to-approval-chains/design.md for the sequencing and the named follow-up.

CommitmentLine.title: CommitmentLine
CommitmentLine.description: A budget-tracking line on a Commitment, one per budget coderingscombinatie (programma + kostenplaats + boekjaar + grootboekrekening). Each regel tracks its own delivery, invoicing, and payment independently so multi-year raamovereenkomsten block budget per boekjaar (D2, REQ-VPL-004).

committedVsRealisedPerBudgetLine.description: REQ-VPL-011: per-budget-line committed-vs-realised rollup, grouped by budget coderingscombinatie (programma + kostenplaats + boekjaar + grootboekrekening). Excludes afgesloten regels. verplicht = sum(restant_verplicht); gerealiseerd = sum(gefactureerd_bedrag); geautoriseerd is joined from the matching CommitmentBudget (administrationId + programmaCode = programma + boekjaar); vrij = geautoriseerd - verplicht - gerealiseerd is computed by the drilldown view (BudgetLineCommitments.vue) from these three declared figures — no parallel PHP reporting service (ADR-031).
committedVsRealisedPerBudgetLine._grammar_note: Rewritten into OpenRegister's actual annotation vocabulary (openregister#2846 + #2849). It previously used `source` and a `sum` list, neither of which the engine reads — the runner recognised the aggregation by NAME and understood none of its body, returning metric:"", field:null, groups:[] against live objects with no error at all (issue #1216). `source` is dropped because this is an intra-schema aggregation declared ON CommitmentLine; `from` is the cross-schema key and would have sent it down a different path. `sum: [a, b]` becomes `metrics: [{metric, field}, ...]`, the multi-metric spelling. `on` uses the explicit {parentField: joinedField} map rather than the string shorthand: the shorthand names only the joined side and leaves the parent side to be inferred from the group fields, which happens to give the right answer here but is a guess, and the map is the only spelling that could express a composite key later.
committedVsRealisedPerBudgetLine._scoping_note: administrationId is NOT declared here, deliberately. It used to read `@self.administrationId`, which is not a placeholder the resolver knows — `$currentUser` is the only one — so it was left literal, matched nothing, and filtered every row away. Declaring it as a constant is impossible because it differs per caller, so scoping is supplied BY the caller as a narrowing filter: BudgetLineCommitments.vue passes filter[administrationId] from /api/administrations/context. openregister#2852 makes that safe — a request filter may ADD a constraint and can never relax or replace a declared one, so this cannot become a way to widen the set. Do not re-add a placeholder here without first checking PlaceholderResolver actually implements it.

Mandate.title: Mandate
Mandate.description: Authorization record defining who may sign commitments up to what amount, for which soort_verplichting, with optional second-signature thresholds (D6, REQ-VPL-002). Enforced by MandateEnforcer on the verplichting aangaan transition. A register (not an enum) so operators can manage mandates over time.

administrationId.title: Administration ID

mandateCode.description: Unique mandate code within the administration.
mandateCode.title: Mandaatcode

maximumAmount.description: Ceiling amount this mandate may sign, in minor units (EUR cents). Use a very large value for unlimited.

status._note: DELIBERATELY LEFT DUTCH — do not anglicise these values piecemeal. RenameDutchValueDecisions::VALUE_MAP is keyed by PROPERTY NAME and every entry applies REGISTER-WIDE, so a `status` entry translating `in_behandeling` or `afgewezen` would also rewrite stored rows of Rechtmatigheidstoets.status, Rechtmatigheidsbevinding.status and JournalEntry.lawfulness.status (bookkeeping-rechtmatigheidsverantwoording.json) plus ReviewWorkflow's nested step/comment statuses (bookkeeping-titel-9-jaarrekening.json) — all of which still declare the Dutch enum. Schema and data would silently desync: OpenRegister does not reject an out-of-enum stored value, the filter just returns nothing. A wholly Dutch enum is honest; a half-renamed one is a trap. Anglicise this only together with those fragments, or after the value map grows a schema-scoped key.
status.title: Status

required_signature.description: Whether this step requires a digital signature.
required_signature.title: Vereist Handtekening

signature_file.description: File URI of the captured signature.
signature_file.title: Handtekening Bestand

Verplichtingenadministratie introduces this register (no prior Budget schema exists in shillinq) so budget can be blocked at commitment-time. vrije_ruimte = geautoriseerd_bedrag - gerealiseerd_bedrag - openstaande_verplichtingen, evaluated on-demand (D4/D9, REQ-VPL-001).
